title: User function body with if/else return inlined as MUX — Tier 4.3 B1 expansion
license: internal regression test, no external reference
problemDescription: Concurrent assign `y <= pick(sel, a, b);` where `pick(s,x,z)` has body `if s = '1' then return x; else return z; end if;`. Tier 4.3 B1 expansion folds this into a MUX cell with S=sel, D1=a, D0=b. Runtime already correct via DeferredUserFunction; this case fences the synth-side inlining of if/else bodies.
